info.title: Melogold API
info.description: Sync server of Melogold: favorites, library, playlists, history and playback across a user's devices. The normative contract is docs/API.md; clients branch only on `code` of ErrorResponse (error-codes.json). There is no version in the URL: compatibility comes from `apiVersion`/`minApiVersion` and `features.sync.protocol` of `GET /server/info` (API §1.1).

servers.description: The official server. Self-hosted servers serve the same API under their own base URL.

get.summary: Readiness: the database answers SELECT 1 within 2 s
get.description: 503 `unavailable` while the server shuts down or without the database (API §4.2).

get.summary: Discovery: server id, versions, features and limits
get.description:
Clients check `software`, `apiVersion`/`minApiVersion` and `features.sync.protocol`/`minProtocol` before using a server (API §7.1). Cacheable for 60 s.

Rate limit: 120/min per IP (IPv6 by /56) (API §1.10).

Find the first nonce "0", "1", … such that sha256(UTF-8(challenge + ":" + nonce)) starts with `bits` zero bits. One use, valid for 10 minutes (API §4.3).

Rate limit: 30/min per IP (IPv6 by /56) (API §1.10).

post.summary: Create an account, its first device and a recovery code
post.description:
Order of checks: registration mode → proof of work → schema → login → taken → password policy (API §4.3). `recoveryCode` of the answer is not null. Not retried automatically: after a network error try login.

Rate limit: 30/hour per IP (IPv6 by /56) (API §1.10).

post.summary: Sign in with login and password
post.description:
A known (user, hwid) reuses its device row; a new device is created with linkedVia=login and counts as new (`recentUntil`). `device_limit_reached` comes only after a correct password (API §4.3).

Rate limit: 60/10 min per IP (IPv6 by /56) (API §1.10).

post.summary: Rotate the refresh token
post.description:
Retried automatically: within REFRESH_GRACE_SECONDS the same unconfirmed successor is returned. Any 401 → AuthRequired (API §1.7, §4.3).

Rate limit: 30/min per refresh token (API §1.10).

post.summary: Remove this device (sign out)
post.description:
Always 204. Acts only with the current token or one within the grace window; the other devices get devices.updated{device_signed_out} (API §4.3).

Rate limit: 30/min per refresh token (API §1.10).

post.summary: Reset the password with the recovery code
post.description:
Every previous device is removed (session.invalidated{recovery_reset}); the new one has linkedVia=recovery. `recoveryCode` of the answer is the new code. Not retried automatically: after a network error log in with the new password (API §4.5).

Rate limit: 20/hour per IP (IPv6 by /56) (API §1.10).

post.summary: New device: start a link and show a QR code (mode request)
post.description:
At most 20 active requests per IP (API §1.10). Not retried automatically.

Rate limit: 30/10 min per IP (IPv6 by /56) (API §1.10).

post.summary: New device: claim an invite scanned from a signed-in device (mode invite)
post.description:
Show `verifyCode` large; the signed-in device approves with it (API §4.6). Not retried.

Rate limit: 30/10 min per IP (IPv6 by /56) (API §1.10).

post.summary: New device: long-poll the link until the session is issued
post.description:
Answers at once when the status differs from `knownStatus`, otherwise waits up to `waitSeconds` (25). After `completed` the same poll returns the same session for 60 s. HTTP client timeout: 35 s (API §4.6).

Rate limit: 60/min per poll secret and 600/min per IP (IPv6 by /56) (API §1.10).

post.summary: New device: cancel the link
post.description: Rate limit: 60/min per poll secret and 600/min per IP (IPv6 by /56) (API §1.10).

get.description:
`text/event-stream`: first `retry: 5000`, then system.connected; each event is `id: <uuid>` + `data: <LiveEvent JSON>` without an `event:` line; heartbeats are comments. No replay (Last-Event-ID is ignored). The server closes the stream at the token's `exp`, after session.invalidated, when auth_version grows and on shutdown; at most 4 streams per device and 64 per user (API §6).

Rate limit: 30/min per user (API §1.10).

The current device first, the others by lastSeenAt descending (API §4.4).

Rate limit: 120/min per user (API §1.10).

patch.description:
`name: null` returns to the reported name. A recently added device must send `password` to rename another device (DESIGN §4.8).

Rate limit: 120/min per user (API §1.10).

post.summary: Revoke another device
post.description:
After commit: session.invalidated{device_revoked} to that device, its streams close, devices.updated{device_removed} to the others (API §4.4). Not retried automatically.

Rate limit: 120/min per user (API §1.10).

post.summary: Sign out every other device
post.description:
The same rules for every target; on 403 no device is removed (API §4.4).

Rate limit: 120/min per user (API §1.10).

post.summary: Change the password
post.description:
Without `currentPassword` the change is allowed from any signed-in device; the others get account.updated{password_changed_without_old}. Always bumps auth_version (API §4.5).

Rate limit: 5/hour per user (API §1.10).

post.summary: Issue a new recovery code
post.description: Rate limit: 5/hour per user (API §1.10).

post.summary: Confirm that the recovery code is saved
post.description: Rate limit: 120/min per user (API §1.10).

post.summary: Delete the account
post.description:
Logical and immediate: the login is free at once, devices are removed, data is purged by a background job (API §4.5).

Rate limit: 5/hour per user (API §1.10).

get.description:
Streamed with `Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="melogold-export-<login>-<YYYY-MM-DD>.json"`. Not an atomic snapshot; contains no secrets (API §4.5).

Rate limit: 3/hour per user (API §1.10).

post.summary: Signed-in device: create an invite and show its QR code (mode invite)
post.description:
`pollSecret` of the answer is null. A fourth active invite cancels the oldest (API §4.6).

Rate limit: 10/10 min per user (API §1.10).

post.summary: Signed-in device: open a request by its QR token or user code (mode request)
post.description:
Exactly one of `linkToken` and `userCode`. The answer has status claimed and verifyChoices.

Rate limit: 20/10 min per user (API §1.10).

get.summary: Signed-in device: the approval card of a link

post.summary: Signed-in device: approve with the number shown on the new device
post.description:
A wrong number denies the link (409 link_verify_mismatch). Only from claimed and only by the approving device; another device gets 404 (API §4.6).

Rate limit: 120/min per user (API §1.10).

post.summary: Signed-in device: deny a link
post.description: Rate limit: 120/min per user (API §1.10).

post.summary: Signed-in device: cancel its invite
post.description: Rate limit: 120/min per user (API §1.10).

parameters.name: X-Sync-Protocol
parameters.description: Sync protocol of the client, within [features.sync.minProtocol, features.sync.protocol] (API §1.2). Missing or not an integer → 400 invalid_request; outside → 409 protocol_unsupported.

post.summary: Plan how local playlists merge with the server ones
post.description:
A pure function: nothing is written. `plan` follows the order of the request (API §4.7).

Rate limit: 10/min per user (API §1.10).

parameters.name: X-Sync-Protocol
parameters.description: Sync protocol of the client, within [features.sync.minProtocol, features.sync.protocol] (API §1.2). Missing or not an integer → 400 invalid_request; outside → 409 protocol_unsupported.

post.summary: Send ops and receive the changes since the cursor
post.description:
Ops are idempotent: a repeated op answers `replayed: true`. Only `opId`, `kind`, `at` and `base` of each op are validated here; a bad field of one op defers that op, never the batch. Work budget: Σ(videoIds + entries + tracks) ≤ 20 000, else 413 (API §1.9, §4.8).

Rate limit: 120/min per user (API §1.10).

get.summary: The current playback state of the account
get.description:
`state: null` when there is none or it was cleared (API §4.9).

Rate limit: 60/min per device (API §1.10).

parameters.name: X-Sync-Protocol
parameters.description: Sync protocol of the client, within [features.sync.minProtocol, features.sync.protocol] (API §1.2). Missing or not an integer → 400 invalid_request; outside → 409 protocol_unsupported.

put.summary: Publish the playback state of this device
put.description:
Rules in order: handed_off, newer_state, 409 playback_queue_required, CAS up to 3 attempts then 503 server_busy (API §4.9, DESIGN §3.12.3).

Rate limit: 30/min per device (API §1.10).

parameters.name: X-Sync-Protocol
parameters.description: Sync protocol of the client, within [features.sync.minProtocol, features.sync.protocol] (API §1.2). Missing or not an integer → 400 invalid_request; outside → 409 protocol_unsupported.

delete.description:
Writes a tombstone, then playback.updated{cleared: true} to the other devices (API §4.9).

Rate limit: 10/min per user (API §1.10).
